unit: cancer x lncRNA x canonical pathway/State
patient_scores: Retained in source-specific definitions and units; not numerically averaged across platforms
primary_target: Relationship membership plus continuous combined p/q and readout effect metadata
strong: Combined BH q <= 0.05 and at least one observed absolute adjusted rho >= 0.20
weak: Combined BH q <= 0.10 and at least one observed absolute adjusted rho >= 0.15, excluding strong
multiplicity: BH across all estimable lncRNA x canonical-target pairs in each cancer x context x primary task; shared Pathway/State identity counted once as Pathway
fusion_method: Two-sided Fisher statistic calibrated using 100000 correlated-normal conditional-null draws; exact single-readout/perfect-dependence cases; Bonferroni only for unknown dependence
null_reference: Label-outcome residual Gram including measurement masks; only used to compute the label test, never as model input or to select models
cohort_integration: Independent cohort blocks after ambiguous retrospective case handling; no absolute TCPA/CPTAC calibration
duplicate_readouts: Identical raw score ranks, same label patients and covariate policy share total weight one; all source names retained
direction: Individual measured-readout association signs retained; mixed signs do not cancel the omnibus association test
individual_modality_support: Individually strict/supporting assay flags retain source-readout BH criteria and are separate from fused significance
cnv_adjustment: Actual signed local CNV for each lncRNA; unmeasured values are missing, never zero-filled
model_training_contract: Positive-unlabelled membership; legacy binary zero-label training is not compatible
